patch_description: A fundamentally different acceptance criterion for local search: instead of minimizing only the single maximum KVPR, we compare the entire sorted KVPR vector lexicographically (full lexicographic balancing). This pushes improvements not just on the worst GPU but on the second-, third-worst, etc., which unlocks moves that a max-only objective rejects (e.g., a move that ties the max but lowers the second-highest GPU). We use multi-start greedy seeds (several orderings) followed by move+swap local search with the full-vector lexicographic acceptance test, plus a final max-only polishing pass. This strictly generalizes the K=3 top-K idea to K=all GPUs at no extra cost for small GPU counts.
